name: color-gradient-slider
title: Color Gradient Slider
description: Multi-stop CSS linear gradient builder with adjustable color stops, angle control, and copyable CSS string.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Monospace
Color: Duotone

## Rules

- Multi Stop Gradient Tuning: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
